newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Clal Israel to post Q4 loss - newspape.
newsitem.headline: Clal Israel to post Q4 loss - newspape.

text.p: Clal Israel, one of Israel's largest holding companies, will post a loss in the fourth quarter of 1996, the Globes financial newspaper reported on Monday.
The newspaper cited estimates that Clal will report a symbolic loss, in part due to compensation packages totalling millions of shekels for senior executives leaving the company.

A spokesman for Clal said he could not comment on the report. Clal Israel will publish its fourth-quarter and full-year results on Thursday while its subsidiary Clal Industries, also a holding company, will report on Tuesday, the spokesman said.
In the fourth quarter of 1995 Clal Israel had net profit of 49 million shekels.
Clal Israel's Clal Trading subsidiary has already reported a loss of 6.9 million shekels for the fourth quarter of 1996.

Globes reported, without citing sources, that Clal Industries would post a loss of 14.7 million shekels in the fourth quarter. For the full year it will report a net profit of 78.7 million shekels against a profit of 246.3 million in 1995, the newspaper said.
